title: AI schism grips Washington as tech, labor vie for upper hand
title_zh: 科技与劳工争夺上风，人工智能分裂席卷华盛顿

title: Almost everything is going wrong for markets right now
title_zh: 目前市场几乎一切都出了问题
summary: The stock market appeared to capitulate to its fears on Friday, with the S&P 500 falling into the 6,300s. But it wasn't just stocks — bonds, gold, bitcoin, and market hopes and dreams all had a rough week.
summary_zh: 周五股市似乎屈服于担忧情绪，标准普尔 500 指数跌至 6,300 点。但不仅仅是股票——债券、黄金、比特币以及市场的希望和梦想都经历了艰难的一周。

title: 'Magnificent 7' stocks wipe more than $850 billion in value as stock market sell-off hits AI winners hard
title_zh: 随着股市抛售严重打击人工智能赢家，“Magnificent 7”股票市值蒸发超过 8500 亿美元
summary: "Magnificent Seven" stocks got hit this week as inflation fears rose and headwinds surfaced for the sector.
summary_zh: 由于通胀担忧加剧以及该行业面临的阻力浮出水面，“七大”股票本周受到打击。
